'''''Galactic Games And Competitions, 27th edition''''' was a publication edited by [[V.F.G. Corvallin]] that was focused on sporting competitions. The publication included brief histories of the sports of [[spheroids]] and [[Grav-ball/Legends|grav-ball]].<ref name="GFT" />
